description: List stored templates, with filters and pagination. Each result has an id (Template ID; null for a template uploaded with versioning: false) and a versionId: pass either as templateId to render_document, download_template or delete_template. Each result lists its tags: to find templates by tag, keep the results whose tags include it.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous response.

id.description: Filter by Template ID (64-bit format, digits only). Cannot be a Version ID.

includeVersions.description: If true, returns all versions for each template. Default: false (only deployed version).

limit.description: 1 to 100 results (default 100); use cursor for more.

origin.description: Upload origin: 0 API (this server), 1 Carbone Studio, 2 Salesforce, 3 Odoo, 4 HubSpot.

search.description: Fuzzy search in template names, or exact match on Template ID / Version ID.

name: list_templates

hasMore.description: Whether more results are available via the cursor.

nextCursor.description: Cursor to pass to the next list_templates call.

title: List Templates
